name: Quarter Tiling
description:
Snap windows into quarters of the screen, with GNOME's own tiling animation and preview.

Keyboard:
* Super+Up on a left/right half moves the window to the top quarter of that side.
* Super+Down on a left/right half moves the window to the bottom quarter of that side.
* Super+Down on a top quarter moves it to the bottom quarter; Super+Up on a bottom quarter moves it to the top quarter.
* Super+Up on a top quarter maximizes the window.
* Super+Left / Super+Right on a quarter moves it to the matching quarter on the other side; pressing toward its own side turns it into a half, as GNOME normally does.

Mouse:
* Drag a window into a corner of the screen to preview the quarter it will fill, then release to snap it there. Corners can be reached along the left, right, top or bottom edge.
* Holding Shift while dragging, or turning off GNOME's edge tiling, disables corner snapping, just like GNOME's own edge tiling.

All other windows keep GNOME's normal Super+Up / Super+Down behaviour.
